inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev7 evidence-bounded rigid skin compatibility, dev6 template-free compilation, dev5 multi-bone/CUBICSPLINE animation, dev4 MOTN/ANIM creation, dev3 TEX synthesis, dev2 schema synthesis, dev1 integrated mod staging, earlier GMX graph/native-builder work and source-only gates are inherited. 2.10.0-dev1 opens a new minor feature line by rebaking non-identity rigid inverse binds into native geometry without claiming blended skinning.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 82/82 selftests plus CLI/GUI version checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: Rigid glTF skin compatibility still requires one unit-weight joint shared by the whole mesh; true blended/multi-joint weights are not encoded because no confirmed native per-vertex skin representation exists.
Non-identity inverse binds must be affine; singular linear transforms are rejected when normals require an inverse-transpose matrix.
MESH.skin_index remains semantically unresolved beyond the repeated corpus-observed 0xFFFF no-vertex-skin value and is not repurposed as a glTF skin index.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free TEX wrapper synthesis remains structurally validated rather than hardware/emulator-proven.
The external dev25 306/306 retail GMX no-op evidence and dev7 player/enemy skin-field evidence are inherited rather than rerun/bundled from proprietary inputs.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
